newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M to open 5 stores in Finland H2 '97.
newsitem.headline: H&M to open 5 stores in Finland H2 '97.

text.p: Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz (H&M) said on Thursday it intends to open five stores in Finland in the second half of 1997.
H&M said in a statement that it would open new stores in Helsinki, Tammerfors, and Vasa later this year.
Finland and France are two new markets the retailer has said it wanted to target.
It anounced in November last year plans to start operations in France in the first half of 1998 with a lease signed for a property in Rue de Rivoli in Paris. Other negotiations are underway.
H&M has about 450 stores across Europe with over 100 shops in Germany, its key market.
